sourceLaw: AI proposes. Policy authorizes. CI proves. Human promotes.
requirements: No provider secrets or certificate private keys in repository source
TXT and SRV records contain metadata/discovery only
Unknown or stale service state never renders GREEN
Public services must have explicit service identifiers and authority labels
Cloudflare/Tunnel/DNS state requires separate runtime receipt before being called active
Write-capable tools may not be surfaced through this portal without a separate Crown-gated policy mutation
